title: Service Contracts: general rules for contract amendments
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs every amendment to a service contract, whatever its kind: who requests it, when it takes effect and is filed, how many may be filed, and on which contracts.

## Formal clauses
1. Amendments are requested by the contract holder.
2. An amendment takes effect only once the customer has signed it, and it is filed the same day, never with a retroactive effective date.
3. A contract takes at most the tier's number of filed amendments per term, counted as the amendments filed on that contract.
4. Amendments may be filed only on an active contract.

These conditions are judged on the line's records of the contract: its status and the amendments already filed on it.

## What a filed amendment is
A signed amendment is filed with the regulator and takes effect on filing. Each filed amendment carries the next sequential amendment number and is of one kind: a commitment change, a term extension, a named account addition or a rate revision. Filing a term extension moves the contract's expiry date; filing a commitment change sets the new commitment.

## How amendments are counted
All filed amendments on the contract count together towards the tier's number of filed amendments. Where a limit applies to one kind of amendment only, the filed amendments of that kind are counted separately for that limit.

## Checklist
| Item | Met when |
|---|---|
| Requested by | the contract holder |
| Signature | the customer has signed the amendment |
| Filing and effect | filed on the day it is signed, with no retroactive effective date |
| Number filed | the contract has not yet reached the tier's number of filed amendments |
| Contract status | active |

## Contract status
| Status | Amendment may be filed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| pending signature, suspended, expired or terminated | no |

## Points of judgement
**Hypothetical limit of 5 filed amendments.** A contract with 4 amendments on file can take one more; a contract with 5 on file cannot take a sixth.

**The customer asks for an amendment dated back to the first of the month.** Not possible: an amendment is never filed with a retroactive effective date.

**The contract is suspended and the customer wants to file an amendment.** Not possible while it is suspended; amendments are filed only on an active contract.
